responseMessageContents.text:
Your Apple Account has been locked by Apple for security reasons — this is an Apple-side account status, not a code or App Store Connect resource issue, so there's nothing I can fix from here.

**What to do:**
1. Go to https://iforgot.apple.com and reset/unlock the Apple ID you use for App Store Connect.
2. After resetting, sign in once at https://appleid.apple.com and https://appstoreconnect.apple.com to confirm the account is fully active (you may need to accept updated agreements).
3. If 2FA is enabled, make sure you have access to a trusted device/phone number.
4. Once unlocked, retry the submission from Rork.

If iForgot doesn't resolve it, contact Apple Support (https://support.apple.com/apple-id) — only they can unlock the account. Let me know once it's unlocked and I'll re-run the submission.
